sentences.l2: 高校を卒業したばかりの10代の彼が選んだ道は、地方の有機農家で働くことでした。
sentences.l1: The path chosen by him, a teenager in his 10s who had just graduated from high school, was to work on an organic farm in the countryside.

sentences.l2: 最初の一年は、美しい田園風景とは裏腹に、泥にまみれた過酷な肉体労働の連続でした。
sentences.l1: The first year was a succession of harsh, mud-covered manual labor, contrary to the beautiful rural scenery.

sentences.l2: しかし、農薬を使わずに野菜を育てるという仕事を通じて、彼は自然の厳しさと、土が命を育むという壮大な仕組みを、自らの肌で実感していくことになります。
sentences.l1: However, through the work of growing vegetables without using pesticides, he will come to feel with his own skin the harshness of nature and the grand mechanism by which soil nurtures life.
